prototypes.title: Word Rush
prototypes.tagline: Read the definition, type the word — every answer buys you five more seconds.

prototypes.title: Koch Code
prototypes.tagline: Learn Morse the Koch way — full speed from the first tone, typing or tapping your answer.
changelog: v2 — fixed the silent tone (audio unlocked and resumed on the Start tap before scheduling), lesson-style session screen with a segmented run bar and a replay button, donut accuracy ring and correct/missed legend on results

prototypes.title: IdeaMuscle
prototypes.tagline: Ten ideas a day, captured in one tap — miss a day and the streak goes slack.

prototypes.title: Letter Lockout
prototypes.tagline: Chain words from a tray of unlocked letters that shrinks under your feet.
changelog: v2 — unlocked-letter tray replaces the strikethrough keyboard, gold bonus letters, zigzag across/down board of letter tiles

prototypes.title: Pasture Push
prototypes.tagline: One swipe slides the whole flock — pen every sheep before the fox gets one.
changelog: v2 — bright toylike restyle (mint field, raised 3D fences, blue water, cream HUD pill and bottom card), irregular non-rectangular boards, added level 5 "Round the Bend"

prototypes.title: Slide & Spell
prototypes.tagline: One swipe slides every letter at once — spell the hidden word, or race the clock in Endless.
changelog: v2 — bright minimal restyle (sage tray, pastel chunky tiles), added timed Endless mode

prototypes.title: Number Sprint
prototypes.tagline: Sixty seconds of mental arithmetic that tunes its own difficulty to you.

prototypes.title: Shift
prototypes.tagline: Swap one card into a four-letter word to forge a new one — twenty seconds a turn.

prototypes.title: Title Shot
prototypes.tagline: Box your way to a world title — every round is one boxing question, right answers land the punch.

prototypes.title: Country Compass
prototypes.tagline: Wordle for world geography — every guess reports how many kilometres it is from the secret country.
